name: Exploud
flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

levelUp.name: Ice Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

levelUp.name: Fire Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

levelUp.name: Thunder Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

levelUp.name: Pound
levelUp.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

levelUp.name: Uproar
levelUp.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

levelUp.name: Astonish
levelUp.description: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Howl
levelUp.description: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

levelUp.name: Uproar
levelUp.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

levelUp.name: Astonish
levelUp.description: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Howl
levelUp.description: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

levelUp.name: Bite
levelUp.description: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Supersonic
levelUp.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

levelUp.name: Stomp
levelUp.description: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Screech
levelUp.description: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Crunch
levelUp.description: The user crunches up the foe with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Roar
levelUp.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

levelUp.name: Rest
levelUp.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

levelUp.name: Sleep Talk
levelUp.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

levelUp.name: Hyper Voice
levelUp.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Hyper Beam
levelUp.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Water Pulse
tmHm.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

tmHm.name: Roar
tmHm.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Taunt
tmHm.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

tmHm.name: Ice Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Blizzard
tmHm.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: SolarBeam
tmHm.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

tmHm.name: Earthquake
tmHm.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Shadow Ball
tmHm.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Brick Break
tmHm.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Shock Wave
tmHm.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

tmHm.name: Flamethrower
tmHm.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

tmHm.name: Fire Blast
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tmHm.name: Rock Tomb
tmHm.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tmHm.name: Torment
tmHm.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Overheat
tmHm.description: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Focus Blast
tmHm.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tmHm.name: Fling
tmHm.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Avalanche
tmHm.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Rock Slide
tmHm.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Surf
tmHm.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Climb
tmHm.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: ThunderPunch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

tutor.name: Fire Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Ice Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Outrage
tutor.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

tutor.name: Zen Headbutt
tutor.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Uproar
tutor.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
